exp.desc:
- Newsletter concept and delivery
- Search ads and product page optimisation
- Monthly reports

cl.p1: During my placement year I rebuilt the newsletter of a small online coffee shop: fewer discounts, more stories about the roasters. Open rates went up and unsubscribes went down. Your tea gardens have at least as many stories.
cl.p2: I graduated in media business this summer. I ran search ads, rewrote product pages for search and built monthly reports for the owners. I like writing and I like numbers, and the best work happens where they meet.
cl.p3: I would happily move to the coast for the right role.

cl.p1: Six years in fashion marketing taught me to think in weeks: new collection, new campaign, new numbers. In B2B a decision takes months – which is exactly why it appeals to me.
cl.p2: I managed a mid six-figure annual budget, led two agencies and rebuilt our tracking so we could finally see which channels sold. We cut several expensive activities afterwards.
cl.p3: I would like to start by talking to your sales team to understand how your customers buy.
